name: Khau cam
summary: A rice from gạo tám. Vietnamnet’s clause says it is like sticky rice with lá cẩm, rich, sticky, and fragrant. A second step and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnamnet, 8 Oct 2015, names it as a use of Mường Thanh tám rice. It is not the five-colour tray of another province.
taste: Vietnamnet says rich, sticky, and fragrant, from lá cẩm. Nothing further was printed.
howToEat: Eat it as that coloured sticky rice. A method beyond the lá cẩm clause, and a price, are Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Check on arrival.
